scope: Two preserved harness-only failures; all databases/uploads belonged to disposable native local PostgreSQL lifecycles. No production fixture or application-source change.

attempts.classification: Harness fixture setup tried inserting an already In-review Report. Native migration boundary correctly rejected it before any request probes.
attempts.correction: Seed Reports as Submitted, then progress their workflow fields forward while preserving content.

attempts.classification: Harness compared pypdf convenience-extracted JPEG pixels, which are recompressed during extraction. The PDF itself retained the exact original JPEG DCT stream.
attempts.correction: For JPEGs decode the original PDF DCT stream; compare all four original photo/direct/repeating signature pixel hashes and exclude every out-of-scope fixture image.

jpegExtractionIsolation.method: One synthetic 64x48 JPEG rendered by unchanged build_report_pdf, compared against original raw PDF DCT data and pypdf convenience image extraction.

limitations: The failed full attempt artifacts remain in ignored local output and are linked by exact SHA-256; only aggregate diagnosis is committed.
The existing HTML renderer embeds photos and direct signatures but leaves repeating-signature URLs as answer text. The volume gate records this explicitly; no renderer fix is included.
